exam.title: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with at least one year using SageMaker and other ML engineering services plus experience in backend development, DevOps, data engineering, MLOps or data science. Practice data contracts/quality/features, traditional ML training/tuning/evaluation, SageMaker deployment and pipelines, monitoring/drift, cost, networking, IAM/KMS and incident recovery. New learners should normally target MLA-C02 because English MLA-C01 delivery ends September 28, 2026.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Deployment and Orchestration of ML Workflows
ML Solution Monitoring, Maintenance, and Security

review.notes: The complete retiring MLA-C01 guide was reconciled with its four weighted domain pages, service scope, live credential transition notice, and public MLA-C02 replacement guide. It prominently records the September 28 English cutoff, the continued non-English C01 boundary until C02 GA, and ME1-C02 beta delivery code while preventing C01 training from being presented as complete C02 coverage. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 40 original checks cover data contracts/quality/features/leakage/bias; model selection/training/tuning/evaluation; inference/IaC/pipelines/tests/retraining; and drift/operations/cost/IAM/KMS/network/artifact security. All 17 external URLs are cataloged: 14 reachable and O'Reilly plus two Udemy pages automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The local replacement link leads to the library's separately validated C02 page. Volatile exam and provider metadata is labeled, and no recalled questions are used.
